title: The Collected Works of Aristotle
author: Aristotle
translator: Translated under the editorship of W. D. Ross (E. M. Edghill, A. J. Jenkinson, G. R. G. Mure, W. A. Pickard-Cambridge and others)
description: Single-volume collection of Aristotle's works in the Oxford translation — the source edition from which the six Organon texts were sliced, plus seventeen further works beyond the logical corpus
rights: Public domain — this is *The Works of Aristotle*, translated under the editorship of W. D. Ross, Oxford 1928. Verified 2026-08-13 from the transcription itself, which carries the editorship line and names its translators; "Barnes" appears nowhere in it, so it is NOT the 1984 Revised Oxford Translation. Published before 1931.
